notes.note: Reviewed the ChatDock input against its cited claims. The visible desktop Inbox New chat action reuses the resolved lazy component for its newly keyed draft. ChatDock still supplies the current Project, hides the covered conversation and uses the existing close and return owners. The shared boundary still loads on first use and supplies Retry. Checked focused draft, setup, dispatch and accessibility tests and private Chromium input, draft handback and replay controls. Other entry points retain their deferred mount, including collapsed, phone, child readers, forks, Home handoff and Personal Board drafts. Pane ownership and placement, responsive controls, API dispatch and configuration contracts, and operator guidance remain accurate. The browser run used loopback replay and did not exercise native devices or live providers.
